integrity: A structural support-decomposition reduction makes the finite basis exhaustive for the stated short lengths. Two reproducible standard-library programs verify distinct-read graph edges, matchings, a 19-word witness and exact rational graph-covering certificate. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp code-size classification only for word lengths two through five. The all-length edge formula and bipartiteness threshold are separately proved. Does not establish optimal code rates or decoding algorithms at longer lengths.
title: A sharp five-letter two-read reconstruction capacity for homopolymer-free words
